elements.name: UserDTO
elements.role: Data Transfer Object representing user registration and profile data contracts.

elements.name: LibraryFacade
elements.role: Primary API entry point and facade providing unified operations for user registration, reservations, study room management, and notifications.

elements.name: JpaUtil
elements.role: Database utility providing EntityManagerFactory creation and transaction management.

elements.name: PersistenceManager
elements.role: Generic persistence gateway wrapping JPA operations (EntityManager) for database access.

elements.name: UserManager
elements.role: Core business logic service responsible for user registration, authentication, credential validation, and profile retrieval.

elements.name: UserRegistry
elements.role: Manages persistence operations and queries for users (students and librarians) via PersistenceManager.

notes: AQ1: The primary API entry point for user registration is LibraryFacade.register(String role, String name, String surname, String email, String password, String identifier).

AQ2: The complete call chain flows from LibraryFacade.register() -> UserManager.register() -> UserRegistry (duplicate and email checks) -> UserFactory (instantiation) -> UserRegistry.registerUser() -> PersistenceManager.save() -> JpaUtil.getEntityManager() -> Database.
AQ3: Validation errors throw IllegalArgumentException for invalid roles, names, passwords, formats, or duplicate emails/identifiers. Persistence failures throw RuntimeException.

AQ4: The exact integration points are PersistenceManager and JpaUtil, using Jakarta Persistence (JPA) over the persistence unit 'reservationsPU' to persist User entity subclasses (Student, Librarian).

AQ5: Core registration logic is implemented in LibraryFacade.java, UserManager.java, UserRegistry.java, and User.java (along with Student.java and Librarian.java); data transfer is handled by UserDTO.java.
